content: (async () => { const baseUrl = 'https://testingcf.jsdelivr.net/gh/Arianagu2332/Kvasir_ST_tool@main/dist/Kvasir/index.js'; const manifestUrl = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arianagu2332/Kvasir_ST_tool/main/library/manifest.json'; try { const response = await fetch(`${manifestUrl}?kvasir_loader=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' }); const manifest = await response.json(); const version = encodeURIComponent(String(manifest.version || Date.now())); await import(`${baseUrl}?kvasir_version=${version}`); } catch (error) { console.error('[Kvasir] 远程版本读取失败，尝试直接加载脚本', error); await import(`${baseUrl}?kvasir_fallback=${Date.now()}`); } })();
